cohort: The study included 50 females undergoing cesarean delivery who had previously experienced a cesarean section.
finding: The addition of intrathecal dexamethasone to bupivacaine significantly enhanced the duration of pain relief, sensory block, and motor block, and reduced postoperative pain scores after cesarean delivery, without increasing side effects or altering onset time.
followup_time: 2 hours after operation (for pain score measurements)
